profile.summary:
I have participated in and have led teams that have developed high-impact, successful software. I have spent most of my career acting as a liaison between scientists and IT professionals, working with both to create innovative solutions to hard problems.

Specialties: software development, moving from an idea to deployment, consensus building, willingness to participate in all aspects required to make a project or product successful
